mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: it connected the nerves, senses and muscles into the same body.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the repaired segment felt mostly like a predictable placement in a marked opening, though the visible scar was a nice reminder of the repair.

surprise.text: The chest and lower body join at the diaphragm while the food pipe, nerves and vessels continue through their own routes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary. Some placements were guided by named slots rather than something I had to figure out, especially the skin segment.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together. Seeing the nerves and blood routes meet the muscles made me curious about that.
